notes: Coral rev3: 5 flattened fans, three branch stages after short 0.3H trunk of thickness 0.15H; overlapping swollen rounded crown and mint neon tip cores. Crown 1.2 x 0.8, coral height 2.4 above y1.6. Crown depth/width limited minimally to source occluder/authorized footprint (ratio 0.833333); height retained.
Rev4: 5 separate flattened fan lobes; upper crown gaps 0.0449; rounded neon tips; trunk 0.15H to 0.10H at split 0.3H. Crown 1.2 x 0.8. Prior footprint limits retained; collider base exact.

Coral rev5: 3 straight flat paddle lobes, 6 rounded neon tips, one central upright lobe; split 0.3H, trunk diameters 0.15H -> 0.10H. Crown W:H 1.200000:1.768620 = 0.678495. Height 2.4; width 1.2; depth envelope 0.8. Upper fork/tip cluster concentrated at 0.63H..H. Initial splay nominal 35..55 degrees; long risers necessarily steeper to retain H and 0.5H width. No rail-driven splay reduction. Narrow skin depth limited to prior 0.8-stud envelope. Crown height measured from actual branch vertices, including paddle cross-sections below the split plane.
